name: Moong Dal Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup yellow moong dal (split green gram), soaked and ground
A pinch of saffron strands soaked in warm milk
instructions: 1. Soak the moong dal for at least 4 hours, then drain and grind into a coarse paste without adding too much water.
2. Heat ghee in a heavy-bottomed pan (kadhai) and add the dal paste.
3. Roast the dal on low heat, stirring continuously for 20-30 minutes until it turns a deep golden brown and the ghee begins to separate from the sides.
4. Meanwhile, heat the milk or water with sugar in a separate vessel until the sugar dissolves.
5. Gradually add the warm sweetened liquid to the roasted dal, stirring constantly to prevent lumps.
6. Add saffron milk and cardamom powder, and continue to cook on low heat until the mixture thickens and absorbs the liquid.
7. Garnish with chopped dry fruits and serve hot.
description: Moong Dal Halwa is an iconic, royal Rajasthani delicacy traditionally prepared during winters, festivals, and weddings. Known for its laborious preparation and rich ghee-laden texture, it is a celebratory dessert that showcases the culinary expertise of North Indian kitchens.
